hypothesis_summary.name: Volatility-of-Volatility Avoidance Diversifier
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: 각 종목의 rolling 6M daily return vol 시계열 자체의 standard deviation(=vol-of-vol) 계산. 높은 vol-of-vol = unpredictable risk regime. Negative direction Z-score (low VoV 선호) → Top 20 EW. Baltussen-Van Bekkum-Van der Grient 2018 RFS의 cross-section anomaly.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: PG0 SR gap 0.807 해소 + H_1676(consensus) + H_1683(seasonality) 이후 3번째 orthogonal diversifier. Vol-of-vol family는 factor taxonomy §9 미구축. Factor DB L23_Vol_Autocorr + L13_Vol_Variance_Ratio 존재하나 standalone 가설 없음. 직관: 'unknown unknowns' 회피가 한국시장 높은 불확실성 환경에 적합 (MRS 63.1 CRISIS).
hypothesis_summary.expected_role_reason: VoV signal은 (1) 수익률 1차 momentum과 독립, (2) 수익률 vol과 구분되는 2차 moment, (3) cross-section에서 'predictability-of-risk'라는 새 차원. STR_1631(quality anchor)/STR_1656(ML risk)/STR_1679v2(Q07+D29)와 모두 직교 가능성.

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Baltussen, Guido, Sjoerd van Bekkum, and Bart van der Grient, 2018, 'Unknown Unknowns: Vol-of-Vol and the Cross Section of Stock Returns', Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis 53, 1615-1651. (NOTE: 실제 저널은 JFQA, 본 hypothesis의 primary reference)
academic_foundation.core_reference: Part A 참조번호 TBD + Baltussen-Van Bekkum-Van der Grient 2018 JFQA (vol-of-vol cross-section anomaly 최초 체계화)
secondary_references: Cremers, Martijn, Michael Halling, and David Weinbaum, 2015, 'Aggregate Jump and Volatility Risk in the Cross-Section of Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 70, 577-614. (variance risk 가격화)
Bali, Turan G., Nusret Cakici, and Robert F. Whitelaw, 2011, 'Maxing out: Stocks as lotteries and the cross-section of expected returns', Journal of Financial Economics 99, 427-446. (관련 lottery 반대)
Ang, Hodrick, Xing, Zhang, 2006, JF — IVOL puzzle (vol-level level anomaly, VoV와 구분)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Baltussen 2018: 높은 vol-of-vol 종목은 average return 낮음 (t-stat -3+). 설명: knightian uncertainty + limits to arbitrage. VoV 높은 종목은 hedging 어려움 → risk-averse 투자자 회피 → mispricing. NOT resolved by fundamentals/size/BM/MOM.
academic_foundation.korean_specific_intuition: 한국 개인 비중 55%+ / 해외 비중 31%+ / 헤지펀드 약함 → limits to arbitrage 강함. VoV puzzle 강도 큰 후보. 한국 실증 cite은 S1 전 확인 필요 (placeholder: Lee 2021 한국재무학회 또는 없음).
academic_foundation.path_b_rationale: 직관: '불확실성의 불확실성'이 한국시장 개인투자자 sentiment 변동성과 결합. Baltussen 2018 primary reference로 학술 foundation 확보. 즉 intuition → paper confirmed.

components.name: VoV_6M_monthly
